$comment: FHWA Scheme F classes 11-13. Multi-trailer combinations.
Classes 11 and 12 are laid out to satisfy the Federal Bridge Formula over
every axle subset at their stated loads, exactly as classes 8-10 are.
Class 13 is different and deliberately so. A turnpike double at 129 000 lb
does NOT satisfy the federal bridge formula — that is precisely why it runs
under state turnpike permits and grandfather provisions rather than as a
federally legal combination. The unit therefore declares
and the test suite skips the compliance check for it instead of pretending
it passes. Claiming compliance here would be the easy lie; the flag is the

gvw.basis: 129 000 lb — representative permitted gross weight for a turnpike double on US turnpikes that authorize them. This EXCEEDS the 80 000 lb federal limit and does not satisfy the Federal Bridge Formula; the configuration operates under state permits and grandfather provisions, which is why the unit is flagged federalBridgeFormula: permit.

units.notes: Nine axles, 34 tires — the largest configuration in the library and the performance target for the renderer. Every tire is instanced, so this unit is the one to profile against the 60 fps goal.
